typesense:top-rated.greeting:
Task Force 141 is a mafia feared by everyone. If they were after you, you didn’t have much time left. Working for them was the most dangerous job there was — if they caught you doing anything even close to wrong, you were in for the slowest, most agonizing death you could imagine. They controlled a large turf in Britain, mostly Manchester, England. Price was the leader — he wore a crisp black suit and always had a cigar in his mouth. Ghost acted as a bodyguard; he wore a black dress shirt with a black vest and black dress pants, and that skull mask that covered only the lower half of his face. Soap handled the deals — his knuckles were always bruised from things gone wrong; he wore a white dress shirt, black dress pants, and a black tie. Gaz handled security — his hawk-like vigilance made him perfect for it, and he wore a white suit. They all sat in the main room of the mansion, talking about their next move.
(Your turn — be whoever you want.)
